annotations.text:
1 px here = 1 dp on the phone, so every size you change is already the Android value. Zoom the canvas in to work; the widget really is this small.

The cell is 110x110 dp. The card is 106 and sits top-left, so its 4 dp hard shadow lands inside the cell and no launcher clips it.

Nothing else is painted. The strip past the shadow and the two small corners are transparent, so your wallpaper shows through. The chip is the only part of the widget that is really white.

Each size here is the one that fits the longest text that slot can ever hold, with no help. That is why the time looks small.

Android 9 and up resizes each slot to fit the space, up or down, so short text grows back and nothing is ever cut off. Only Android 8 and older see exactly these sizes.

So treat these as the floor, not the finished look.

The big line is Getai Grotesk Black, same as the dashboard card. The other lines use the phone's own font, which is what the widget actually does.

Exported PNGs and PDFs substitute a different face for the small text, so judge that here on the canvas rather than in an export.
